class.name: JRPGGameState
class.brief_description: Everything a JRPG remembers while it is played, saved and loaded as a [Dictionary].
class.description: Holds the switches, variables, self switches, the party with its gold, steps and inventory, the actor states, the player's position, the current map's event states, system flags (save, menu, encounter and formation access, window tone, battle music, timer), the [JRPGRandomStreams] and the [JRPGSimClock] of a game. [method serialize] converts the state to a [Dictionary] of plain values in a canonical form: saving, loading and saving again gives an equal [Dictionary] with the same bytes. [method deserialize] checks the whole input before changing anything. Online, zone servers hold the authoritative state of each character and of the world; clients keep a copy to show their own event pages and never send it back.

method.name: add_party_member
method.description: Adds an actor at the end of the party, creating its actor state while a database is attached. Returns [code]false[/code] when the actor is already a member or the attached database has no such actor.

method.name: add_playtime_steps
method.description: Adds [param steps] simulation steps (60 per second) of play time. Negative values are refused.

method.name: attach_database
method.description: Gives every actor state the database after [method deserialize], so parameters and limits are computed again, and clears references to entries deleted since the save: actors and party members whose actor is gone, inventory entries, and each actor's class, skills, states and equipment ([method JRPGActorState.repair_references]). Prints one warning when something was cleared and returns how many references were fixed.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets everything to the state before a new game, with every random stream seeded from 0 and the clock at 0.

method.name: clear_window_tone_override
method.description: Removes the window tone set during play, so windows use the tone from [JRPGSystemData] again.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Replaces the state with [param data], a [Dictionary] made by [method serialize]. Unknown keys are ignored and missing sections keep their defaults. Call [method attach_database] afterwards so actors compute their parameters. Malformed data, another format or a newer format version return an error ([constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] or [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED]) and leave the state unchanged.

method.name: ensure_actor
method.description: Returns the state of actor [param actor_id], creating it from [param database] the first time. Returns [code]null[/code] when the database has no such actor.

method.name: ensure_event_state
method.description: Returns the state of event [param event_id] on the current map, creating an empty one when there is none.

method.name: gain_gold
method.description: Changes the party's gold by [param amount], keeping it between 0 and [constant MAX_GOLD]. Returns the new amount.

method.name: gain_item
method.description: Changes how many of an item, weapon or armor the party holds by [param amount], keeping the count between 0 and [constant MAX_ITEM_COUNT]. Returns the new count. Equipped weapons and armors are not counted here.

method.name: get_actor
method.description: Returns the state of actor [param actor_id], or [code]null[/code] when the actor was never used.

method.name: get_actor_ids
method.description: Returns the IDs of every actor used so far, in ascending order.

method.name: get_clock
method.description: Returns the simulation clock of this game.

method.name: get_database
method.description: Returns the database given to [method start_new_game] or [method attach_database], or [code]null[/code]. It is not saved.

method.name: get_db_content_hash
method.description: Returns the content hash of the database this state was saved with.

method.name: get_db_schema_version
method.description: Returns the schema version of the database this state was saved with.

method.name: get_event_state
method.description: Returns the state of event [param event_id] on the current map, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_event_state_ids
method.description: Returns the IDs of the events that have a saved state, in ascending order.

method.name: get_events_map_id
method.description: Returns the map the event states belong to.

method.name: get_events_map_revision
method.description: Returns the revision number of the map data the event states were saved with.

method.name: get_game_id
method.description: Returns the id of the game this state belongs to (from [member JRPGSystemData.game_id]).

method.name: get_gold
method.description: Returns the party's gold.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns how many of the item, weapon or armor [param id] the party holds.

method.name: get_item_ids
method.description: Returns the IDs of every item, weapon or armor of [param kind] the party holds, in ascending order.

method.name: get_map_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the map the player is on (0 when none).

method.name: get_music_override
method.description: Returns the music set during play for [param slot], or [code]null[/code] when the [JRPGSystemData] music is used.

method.name: get_party_members
method.description: Returns the actor IDs of the party in formation order.

method.name: get_player_cell
method.description: Returns the map cell of the player.

method.name: get_player_direction
method.description: Returns the direction the player faces.

method.name: get_playtime_seconds
method.description: Returns the play time in whole seconds.

method.name: get_playtime_steps
method.description: Returns the play time in simulation steps (60 per second).

method.name: get_random
method.description: Returns the random streams of this game. They are saved with the state.

method.name: get_revision
method.description: Returns a number that grows whenever something event pages depend on changes (switches, variables, self switches, inventory, party). Maps compare it to refresh their pages at most once per step. It is not saved.

method.name: get_self_switch
method.description: Returns whether self switch [param letter] ([code]"A"[/code] to [code]"D"[/code]) of event [param event_id] on map [param map_id] is on.

method.name: get_steps
method.description: Returns how many steps the party has walked.

method.name: get_switch
method.description: Returns whether switch [param id] is on. IDs start at 1; switches never set are off.

method.name: get_timer_seconds
method.description: Returns the timer's remaining time in whole seconds, rounded up.

method.name: get_timer_steps
method.description: Returns the timer's remaining time in simulation steps.

method.name: get_variable
method.description: Returns the value of variable [param id]: an [int], a [float] or a [String]. Variables never set are 0.

method.name: get_variables
method.description: Returns a copy of the variables as an [Array] indexed by variable ID (index 0 is unused).

method.name: get_window_tone_override
method.description: Returns the window tone set during play. Only meaningful when [method has_window_tone_override] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: has_item
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the party holds at least one of the item, weapon or armor [param id].

method.name: has_window_tone_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a window tone was set during play.

method.name: increase_steps
method.description: Counts one step of the party and returns the new total.

method.name: is_encounters_enabled
method.description: Returns whether random encounters can happen.

method.name: is_formation_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the player can change the party formation.

method.name: is_menu_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the player can open the menu.

method.name: is_party_member
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the actor is in the party.

method.name: is_save_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the player can save.

method.name: is_timer_working
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the timer is started.

method.name: prune_event_states
method.description: After loading, drops the states of events that the current map no longer has ([param existing_event_ids] lists the map's events), with one warning. Returns how many were dropped.

method.name: remove_event_state
method.description: Forgets the state of one event. Returns [code]false[/code] when it had none.

method.name: remove_party_member
method.description: Removes an actor from the party. Returns [code]false[/code] when the actor was not a member.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns the whole state as a [Dictionary] of plain values (no objects), ready to be stored in a save. The same state always gives the same [Dictionary], with keys in the same order.

method.name: set_database_version
method.description: Records the schema version and content hash of the database the game runs with, so loading can detect a changed database.

method.name: set_encounters_enabled
method.description: Allows or forbids random encounters.

method.name: set_events_map
method.description: Sets the map the event states belong to and the revision of its data. Entering another map forgets the previous map's states: other maps start from their data.

method.name: set_formation_enabled
method.description: Allows or forbids changing the party formation.

method.name: set_game_id
method.description: Sets the id of the game this state belongs to.

method.name: set_gold
method.description: Sets the party's gold, kept between 0 and [constant MAX_GOLD].

method.name: set_menu_enabled
method.description: Allows or forbids opening the menu.

method.name: set_music_override
method.description: Replaces the battle, victory or defeat music during play with a copy of [param cue]. [code]null[/code] or an empty cue restores the [JRPGSystemData] music. Other slots are refused.

method.name: set_party_members
method.description: Replaces the party with [param actor_ids], in formation order, creating actor states while a database is attached. IDs below 1, repeated actors and actors the attached database does not have are refused.

method.name: set_player_position
method.description: Sets the player's map, cell and facing direction.

method.name: set_save_enabled
method.description: Allows or forbids saving.

method.name: set_self_switch
method.description: Turns self switch [param letter] ([code]"A"[/code] to [code]"D"[/code]) of event [param event_id] on map [param map_id] on or off.

method.name: set_switch
method.description: Turns switch [param id] on or off. IDs go from 1 to [constant MAX_SWITCH_ID].

method.name: set_variable
method.description: Sets variable [param id] to an [int], a finite [float] or a [String] (a [StringName] is stored as a [String]). IDs go from 1 to [constant MAX_VARIABLE_ID]; growing the variables fills the new ones with 0.

method.name: set_window_tone_override
method.description: Sets a window tone during play; each component is kept between -255 and 255.

method.name: start_new_game
method.description: Clears the state and applies the starting values of [param database]: game id, starting party (IDs without an actor entry are skipped) with their actor states, start position, and random streams seeded from [param seed]. The same database and seed always give the same state. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] and changes nothing when System data has no start position.

method.name: start_timer
method.description: Starts the countdown timer at [param seconds], kept between 0 and [constant MAX_TIMER_SECONDS].

method.name: step_timer
method.description: Counts one simulation step down while the timer works. Returns [code]true[/code] on the step the timer reaches 0.

method.name: stop_timer
method.description: Stops the timer, keeping its remaining time.

constants.constant: Version of the format written by [method serialize]. Older versions are converted when loading; newer ones are refused.
Highest event ID a self switch can belong to.
Most the party can hold of one item, weapon or armor.
Most gold the party can hold.
